items.question: How do waters purify the child through the aghora piṇḍa mantra?
items.inference: The verse petitions waters to purify the child by the aghora piṇḍa mantra.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic force of mantrataḥ remains context-dependent.
items.plain_english: May the waters indeed purify you, child, by the aghora piṇḍa mantra.
